notice: Operator-declared labelling. Identity is NEVER inferred from similarity -- that would calibrate the measurement against itself. Every rule rests on evidence independent of the score being fitted.

rules.label: GENUINE
rules.basis: Probe is a photograph of a serving head of government. Candidates restricted to the subject's OWN official domain (narendramodi.in) and established national news outlets that published the image captioned as depicting him. Labelled by source attribution -- the method used to build LFW -- and carrying the same weakness: a mis-captioned photograph becomes a mislabel. Domains with weak or unverifiable attribution (image aggregators, unknown hosts) are deliberately EXCLUDED rather than assumed.

rules.label: IMPOSTOR
rules.basis: Probe is the operator's own face. Candidates are profile photographs published under DIFFERENT named third parties -- other individuals' social profiles, other account IDs' avatars, and stock photography. Different named party implies different identity. This label does not depend on any similarity measurement.
